reason: I already know the breach I'm looking up, and I'd grab an easy claim if it was really one click and free, but a site that is free during beta and wants an account is going to charge me later. I can Google the official form myself without handing anyone my email.
objection: If it's free during beta, what's the catch later? I am not signing up so you can flip on a fee after I already gave you my information.
would_change_my_mind: Let me search my named breach and open the official claim form with no account, and keep it free — not a later subscription for a list I still have to double-check myself.
